item.title: Lil Nas X Shares Statement After Latest Court Appearance
item.description: In August of last year, Lil Nas X was arrested and hospitalized after acting erratically in Los Angeles and allegedly injuring cops who approached him. item.title: David Gilmour’s Strat Breaks Record For Most Expensive Guitar Ever Sold
item.description: In 2019, David Gilmour broke the record for most expensive guitar ever sold when his 1969 Black Fender Stratocaster was auctioned off for $3,975,000. Now, the Pink Floyd guitarist's iconic instrument has broken the record again, this time selling for $12.1 million, according to Rolling Stone.
